messages:
deploy-bot: deploybot detected a mismatch while promoting release 422 from canary -> prod; blocking promotion: secret 'router-sa-token' encoding differs between staging and prod. hold recommended.

alex: can you paste the diff? is it a padding/base64 thing or completely different key name?

deploy-bot: found diff via `kubectl -n inference get secret router-sa-token -o yaml` between namespaces. snippet:```
# staging
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
data:
  token: "YWFhYmJiY2NjZA=="
---
# prod
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
data:
  token: "!!binary" # looks like helm templating produced different encoding
```

priya: ugh, that's the stringData -> data switch we hit before. last time helm chart used stringData in staging but CI templater wrote raw binary into prod during image pin step.

marco: is this going to cause the router to reject the SA token or just log warnings? any live errors?

jenna: prod router logs show 401s to KMS when trying to decrypt downstream creds. small spike ~2m ago, likely due to token format. we should not promote until we confirm token format parity.

ops-bot: flagged release 422 -> HOLD. Adding label release:hold and notifying infra-oncall.

alex: proposed action: 1) hold promotion (done), 2) pin the chart to use explicit stringData in values and re-render CI templater, 3) rerun a dry-run diff to confirm. I can open a quick PR.

priya: agree. also add a post-merge smoke check script: `kubectl -n inference get secret router-sa-token -o jsonpath='{.data.token}' | base64 --decode` and assert it decodes to ascii token pattern. will add to release pipeline.

marco: what about rollback? the canary is partially promoted to prod traffic ramp; do we revert the image or just fix secret?

jenna: safest is to pin image back to previous digest for the short term. hotfix for chart is low-risk but we need coordination window to rotate token if we change encoding.

alex: opening PR now: #427 - helm: force stringData for router service account token, and add smokecheck. aiming for review in 20m.

priya: scheduling a short maintenance window 02:00-02:30 UTC tomorrow to apply change and run canary -> prod promotion. posting to release notes and change calendar.

ops-bot: created incident ticket INF-710 with links to PR and logs. tagging @oncall-infra.

marco: ok - action items for this thread: alex PR + CI smokecheck, jenna revert canary image to prev digest if we see more 401s, priya add smokecheck to pipeline and own post-merge deploy, ops to coordinate change window and update release notes.

jenna: I'll queue the rollback playbook if errors >5% in next 30m.

alex: PR posted: https://git.internal/redwood/charts/pull/427 - includes repro steps and a test command. please review.

priya: reviewed and approved. merging after CI passes.

deploy-bot: CI dry-run passed, secret encoding now matches in staging and prod preview. releasing hold label pending change window.

ops-bot: change window confirmed for 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC. release notes updated: "Hold lifted pending scheduled maintenance to fix SA token encoding parity; minimal risk hotfix; rollback plan in INF-710."

marco: thanks everyone. postmortem if anything unexpected happens. :thumbsup:
